purpose: Define session renewal, idle expiry, absolute expiry and channel termination so session authority cannot survive beyond explicit authentication evidence lifetimes.

owns: IAM Session Renewal and Expiry semantics

topics.name: IAM Session Renewal and Expiry
topics.purpose: Define session renewal, idle expiry, absolute expiry and channel termination so session authority cannot survive beyond explicit authentication evidence lifetimes.

semantics.renew_rule: Renewal requires an exact active session and applicable valid authentication evidence.
semantics.absolute_rule: Absolute lifetime cap is explicit where configured.
semantics.reauth_rule: Renewal may require reauthentication according to policy.
semantics.channel_rule: Channel close effects are explicit rather than assumed.
semantics.failure_rule: Unknown expiry state fails protected use closed.

invariants.rule: Identity, authentication assurance, authorization policy, authorization decision, delegation and runtime execution remain separate machine-significant identities/evidence; no one layer silently substitutes for another.

Ambiguous, missing, stale or unverifiable authority for a protected effect fails closed rather than inheriting trust from locality, transport reachability, process ownership, UI visibility or previous success.

hard_gates.condition: channel close always assumed logout without profile
